title: Global And Local Inversions
description: Check if the number of global inversions is equal to the number of local inversions in an array.

steps.note: Initialize maxSoFar to 0 to track the maximum element seen so far.
Start loop at i = 0. Compare nums[i] with nums[i+2].
Check if maxSoFar (1) > nums[i + 2] (2). 1 > 2 is false. Continue.
End of loop, condition i < n-2 (0 < 1) met. Loop terminates.
Return true as no condition maxSoFar > nums[i+2] was met.
